# <module dir>:<packages>:<forbidden import path regexp>
# NFR-005: the evaluator and the configuration formats import no telemetry, transport or platform clients.
# NFR-011: the evaluator interfaces carry neither the JsonLogic engine nor the JSON schema library.
core:./pkg/evaluator:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema
core:./pkg/evaluator/...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema
core:./pkg/configformat/...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema|core/pkg/evaluator|openfeature-relay/(sync|evaluator)/
# The service interfaces and the OFREP models stay light.
core:./pkg/service/...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema
# The core module imports no telemetry, transport, platform client, JsonLogic engine, schema library or other library module.
core:./...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|jsonlogic|jsonschema|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat)/
# NFR-005, NFR-011: the embeddable modules import no telemetry, transport or platform clients, and flagd's
# configuration format knows no evaluator, engine or sync provider.
evaluator/flagd:./...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry)/
configformat/flagd:./...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|core/pkg/evaluator|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator)/
# Q2: the sync providers import no telemetry and no other sync module.
sync/file:./...:go.opentelemetry.io|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/flagd-grpc:./...:go.opentelemetry.io|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|http|openfeature-operator|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/http:./...:go.opentelemetry.io|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|openfeature-operator|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/openfeature-operator:./...:go.opentelemetry.io|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
# Q12: each blob provider pulls only its own cloud's SDK into its package graph; the base none. (gocloud's shared user-agent code
# brings a few cloud.google.com/go/auth packages into every driver that uses it, so azblob names the GCS SDK instead.)
sync/blob:./...:cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/gcs:./...:github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/azblob:./...:cloud.google.com/go/storage|github.com/aws|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|s3|builder))
sync/s3:./...:cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|builder))
# The sync builder dispatches to the sync modules and knows no telemetry module.
sync/builder:./...:openfeature-relay/telemetry/
# The telemetry module imports core only: no sync module and no platform client.
telemetry/otel:./...:openfeature-relay/sync/|k8s.io|gocloud|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws
# BR-009 and FR-048: an engine module's format and evaluator import core only, no telemetry, transport, platform client,
# JsonLogic engine or other library module (the module's tests run a distribution and carry flagd's runtime).
test/configformat-example:. ./evaluator:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat)/
